name: The Promblem
source:
The prettiest cat girl in the whole school.. She's aiming for Prom Queen. You're aiming for a dance with her. And you have five days to get yourself together.

With the support of your friends, experience the world of cats and rabbits through the eyes of a mixed kid looking for their place in the world. Relive the horrors and joy that is high school. Find out who is safe and who is not.

Shortly explore a world filled with cats, rabbits, and all inbetween, and the life of someone who's accepted by no single community. Express yourself through choices that show response and change appearance.

Pick your 'fit, impress your friends, and maybe even win a date with Priscilla.. if you can manage not to mess everything up!

[From [url=https://mega-gh0st.itch.io/the-promblem]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
全校最漂亮的猫女孩。她的目标是舞会女王。你的目标是和她跳舞。你有五天时间让自己振作起来。

在朋友的支持下，通过混血孩子的眼睛体验猫和兔子的世界，寻找自己在世界上的位置。重温高中的恐怖和欢乐。找出谁是安全的，谁是不安全的。

很快就会探索一个充满猫、兔子和所有介于两者之间的世界，以及一个不被任何社区接受的人的生活。通过表现出反应和改变外观的选择来表达自己。

选择你的“合适”，给你的朋友留下深刻印象，甚至可能赢得与普里西拉的约会……如果你能设法不把一切搞砸的话！

[来自[url=https://mega-gh0st.itch.io/the-promblem]Itch.io[/url]]
